title: feat: unify console layout with horizontal top navigation
body:
Replaces the left sidebar + top header layout in app pages (`/apps/:appName/*`) with a horizontal top navigation bar, matching the existing home page pattern. ## Changes - **New `AppTopNav` component**: Horizontal navigation with app switcher, primary nav items, search, activity feed, help, theme/locale toggles, and user menu. Supports dropdown groups and mobile-responsive layout. - **Simplified `ConsoleLayout`**: Removed `AppShell`, `UnifiedSidebar`, and `AppHeader` dependencies. Now renders a simple flex container with `AppTopNav` at top and content below. Branding (colors, favicon, title) moved to `useEffect` hooks. - **Consistent UX**: Both `/home` and `/apps/:appName/*` now use top navigation, creating a unified modern layout with more horizontal screen space. ## Layout Comparison **Before:** ```tsx } navbar={}> {children} ``` **After:** ```tsx
{children}
``` Navigation items render horizontally with visibility/permission checks preserved. Groups become dropdown menus. Mobile view collapses nav into a dropdown menu.
